items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: But I would play with the navy band also, and Vernon Alley and I would play civilian jobs.

ctx.x: This was in Oakland. Yeah, with Benny Green and the trumpet player now who's with Sammy Davis. What's his name? Ricardo -- Rick Ricardo. We called him Flip. But any way we had a very good band, very good band ourselves. But I would play with the navy band also, and Vernon Alley and I would play civilian jobs. But any way being there was just nice because I got a chance to see everybody. And in Oakland at that time. Well, this was during the war.
